name: PEPlife2_search_peptides
description: Search PEPlife 2.0 (Raghava lab, IIITD) for experimentally measured peptide HALF-LIFE / proteolytic-stability records. Filter by 'lin_cyc' (Linear or Cyclic), 'org' (origin organism / incubation media), or 'seq' (sequence). Each record returns the peptide sequence, half-life value and units, protease, incubation time, concentration, assay, linear/cyclic form, chirality, chemical and N/C-terminus modifications, origin, nature, PubMed ID, and year. Use to assess therapeutic-peptide stability / druggability. Keyless public API.

dataType.description: Field to filter on. One of: 'lin_cyc' (Linear or Cyclic), 'org' (origin organism / incubation media), or 'seq' (sequence). Default: 'lin_cyc'.

dataValue.description: Value to match for the chosen dataType. Examples: 'Linear' (with dataType=lin_cyc) -> ~3777 records; 'Cyclic' (with dataType=lin_cyc) -> ~49 records.

id.description: The database's own identifier for the peptide entry.

seq.description: The amino-acid sequence in one-letter code.

nter.description: N-terminal modification, e.g. acetylation. A free versus a blocked terminus changes stability and activity.

chiral.description: Stereochemistry of the residues -- L, D or mixed. D-amino acids resist proteolysis, so this changes the half-life more than the sequence does.

lin_cyc.description: Whether the peptide is linear or cyclic. A cyclised peptide is a different molecule from the same sequence left linear.

nature.description: The peptide's class or origin as the database records it.

origin.description: Where the peptide came from -- the organism, or the design it was derived from.

pmid.description: PubMed ID of the paper reporting it.

units_half.description: The UNIT the half-life is expressed in -- minutes, hours, days. The number alone is unusable without it.

protease.description: The protease or medium the peptide was challenged with. A half-life in trypsin and one in serum are different measurements.

test_sample.description: The matrix the test ran in, e.g. serum, plasma, buffer.

vivo_vitro.description: Whether the half-life was measured in vivo or in vitro. An in vitro half-life does not predict the in vivo one.

patent_no.description: Patent number, where the peptide is patented.

half_life.description: The measured half-life -- what this database exists to record. Read it with `assay`, `conc` and `incubation_time`: a half-life in serum and one in plasma are different numbers.

assay.description: The assay the half-life was measured in.

incubation_time.description: How long the incubation ran. A half-life longer than the incubation is an extrapolation.

dose_route.description: Route of administration, where measured in vivo.

activity_sub.description: The activity the peptide was assayed for.

oneOf.description: Matching half-life records. Each has id, pmid, year, seq, name, length, lin_cyc, chiral, chem_mod, cter, nter, origin, nature, incubation_time, conc, half_life, units_half, protease, assay.
